description: Turn what the person earned into money: to their bank account, their mobile money, or "Digital dollars (USDC)" to their own Base account, where offered. Speak plainly to the person: no technical words. One step per call: it reads what they have available, their LinkedIn and identity check, then asks the country, the way to get paid (every way is listed; the ones they can't pick say why), the amount and (for digital dollars) the 0x address, and shows "You'll receive $X (fee $0)". With confirm: true it gives ONE link: the person opens it and taps Confirm there, where their identity is checked and they confirm in their sign-in app. Limits and fees come from IXO's cash-out service, never from here. No LinkedIn: say connect_linkedin first. Signs no money and holds no key of theirs.

amount_usd.description: How much, in dollars, like "25" or "25.50".

confirm.description: true, after the person said yes to the quote: gives the one link to confirm.

country.description: Where the person lives: two letters, like NG or DE.

method.description: The way to get paid, as cash_out listed it (like usdc_base).

network.description: Which deployment: `mainnet` is the real network (real money); `testnet` is the sandbox (play money, a dry run).

to.description: Base account only: the 0x… address that receives it.
